items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: I had Freddie Kepard and King Oliver in the same job.

ctx.x: Did you hear Freddie Kepard too? I guess you... I had Freddie Kepard. And that was my favorite.

I had Freddie Kepard and King Oliver in the same job. How did they all compare? They didn't get long, because Freddie always wanted more money than Joe. Freddie thought he could get better. Well, he got it. Yeah, he did, because he, I don't want no use, but I want $50 a week. He called him King Kepard.
Well, what does that story, he said, how the reason you and Bishay broke up, the reason he left the band?
